articles.title: Congo Launches Ebola Vaccine Drive for Front-Line Workers in Outbreak Epicenter
articles.summary: Congo began vaccinating health workers in Bunia on Saturday as it battles its deadliest Ebola outbreak ever. The vaccine, Ervebo, was designed for a different Ebola strain, so scientists are studying whether it protects against the Bundibugyo virus now spreading.

articles.title: US and Denmark Strike Greenland Security Deal, Ending Months of Tension
articles.summary: The US and Denmark announced a deal on Greenland's security Saturday, after Trump threatened to seize the island. The agreement gives the US a role in defending Greenland but recognizes Danish sovereignty. Leaders expect to sign it at the UN next week.

articles.title: Trump Announces 'AI Force' and an AI Tsar, Calls Safety Worries a 'Hoax'
articles.summary: President Trump says the U.S. will create an 'AI Force' and appoint an AI tsar to lead it. In a Saturday post he rejected calls to slow AI down, saying it could reach 25% of America's GDP.
